effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect deletes one of your other Digimon, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Gammamon] in its text in your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 [Hiro Amanokawa] from your hand without paying the cost.
